method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

checks.command: l4 run ea-elector.l4 ; l4 run ea-cases-elector.l4 ; l4 run ea-qa.l4 ; l4 run ea-qa-cases.l4 ; l4 check ea-qa.l4
checks.result: 303 assertions satisfied (66 baseline + 237 Q&A layer, 2026-11-06), 0 errors, 0 warnings in all four files; l4 check ea-qa.l4: Check succeeded; parameter script: 42 exports, my role first everywhere, each situation input second and identical wherever taken, one type and @desc per input name, no DEONTIC or EVENT input
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the State elector: ss 4 (elector, enrolled), 17 (entitlement to be enrolled and vote; polling-day enrolment and provisional vote), 17AA (enrolment at 16 and 17, from 1 July 2024), 18 (people barred), 31, 31A, 35A (single enrolment procedure and Commonwealth information, as inputs), 45 (offences of not being enrolled after 21 days and not notifying a new address; $50; bars on proceedings including a Commonwealth claim), 155AB and 156 (the duty to vote, the valid and sufficient reason, the penalty notice, the $50/$75 caps, the infringement notice, removal from the register, the $200 and $1 000 fines). Out: administration, districts, the register's claim and objection machinery, ss 17(4), 17A, 17B, 51A, 51B, voting procedure, s 156AA, everything after s 156; the 2021 text for c024.

roles: I am, or may be entitled to be, a State elector
I employ someone who is a State elector
I am a candidate, or want to stand, at a State election

situation_parameters.name: I have been sent a penalty notice for not voting
questions: Is the response date in my notice lawful under the Act
How much at most can the modified penalty in my notice be
Does my response to the penalty notice stop a prosecution for not voting
May the Electoral Commissioner send me an infringement notice
Can I still be prosecuted for failing to vote at this election
May another elector respond to my notice for me
Must my name be removed from the register for not responding to my notice

situation_parameters.name: I have changed my address within my district
questions: By when must I tell the Electoral Commissioner my new address
Can I be prosecuted for not telling the Electoral Commissioner my new address

situation_parameters.name: I am on the Commonwealth roll for an address in Western Australia
questions: Does my Commonwealth enrolment reach the State register of electors

situation_parameters.name: I am an employee
questions: May I have leave from work to vote
What is the most I can be fined for getting leave to vote without meaning to vote

situation_parameters.name: an employee has asked me for leave to vote
questions: Must I allow my employee leave of absence to vote
How long a leave of absence to vote must I allow at the most
What is the most I can be fined for not allowing leave to vote

situation_parameters.name: the election has been held and the votes counted
questions: After the election is my deposit returned and to whom
